messages.author: 81f2b59b0f0a2d1f
messages.subject: Extract y-axis labels
parts:
First of all, I'd like to state my appreciation for all the work
that's gone into ggplot2.

After trolling around lists for awhile, I've been unable to find an
answer to this question.

Suppose I have a figure generated by this code:

R> library(ggplot2)
R> df <- data.frame(x=1:100, y=1:100)
R> p <- ggplot(df, aes(x, y))+ geom_point()

Is there a way to systematically extract the y-axis labels? In this
simple case, I'd like to extract 20, 40, 60, 80, 100. I have tried
looking through the output generated by:

R> str(p)

and was able to extract the y-axis title but not the labels.

Any suggestions would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks,
Edward
